Notes / comments (17)
  • number of LinearPerMetapath projection layers inside PaperTower. Each layer transforms the metapath features through a learned weight matrix.
  • randomly zeros 50% of activations during training inside PaperTower to prevent overfitting. Disabled at evaluation time
  • randomly zeros 50% of input features during training inside PaperTower to prevent overfitting. Disabled at evaluation time
  • scales the similarity scores in the InfoNCE loss. Lower value makes the loss sharper and more sensitive to small differences between positive and negative pairs. 0.07 is the standard value from contrastive learning literature.
  • maximum number of tokens SciBERT reads from each citation context
  • learning rate for SciBERT weights (verry low). Very small because SciBERT is already pretrained on scientific text —> we fine-tune it gently rather than retrain it
  • learning rate for the projection head weights. Higher because these weights are randomly initialized and need to learn quickly.
  • learning rate for the PaperTower weights. Higher because these weights are randomly initialized and need to learn quickly.
  • fixed random seed generator for reproducibility
  • index of the GPU to use for training. 0 means the first GPU in the system.
  • number of attention heads in the cross-metapath self-attention layer inside PaperTower. 1 means no multi-head attention.
  • the size of the final output vector from both towers — kept fixed at 768 across the sweep so it always matches ContextTower.
  • hidden dim of LinearPerMetapath and the Transformer (use_mlp=True routes features through hidden=500 before fusion).
  • runs metapath features through LinearPerMetapath (nfeat=768 -> hidden=500) before the Transformer.
  • dropout applied to attention weights inside the Transformer (cross-metapath fusion), to prevent overfitting on attention scores.
  • activation applied to attention scores before softmax inside the Transformer. Options: sigmoid, relu, leaky_relu, none.
  • adds a skip connection from mean(inputs) -> hidden, added to the fc_after_concat output before the final projection.
